content.context: Compared GitLab origin/master and GitHub github/master. GitHub was behind by 2 commits: dd6cad8 and 0ca217a. Added repository Git-flow push policy requiring remote comparison and explicit GitLab/GitHub/both selection. Pushed master to both remotes; both now point to d24d26e.
content.decision: Treat origin as GitLab and github as GitHub; when the user requests both, publish the same branch tip to both remotes and verify identical commit IDs.
content.rationale: Do not assume one remote mirrors another. Check ahead/behind counts first, ask for destination when unclear, and verify both remote tips after pushing. Keep this rule in repository AGENTS.md so Git-flow agents detect it automatically.

summary: Treat origin as GitLab and github as GitHub; when the user requests both, publish the same branch tip to both remotes and verify identical commit IDs.
title: chore(git): sync configured remotes
